reviews.title: No proper proof of purchase
reviews.body:
UPDATE: Issue fully resolved, excellent response from Lebara's complaints team

My original review described a poor experience with live chat: I couldn't get proper proof of purchase for my Travel eSIM and was refused escalation.

I'm pleased to say Lebara's complaints team has since put this right. They phoned me, apologised sincerely, and assured me they would make sure their staff handle this differently in future. They then emailed me a much clearer and more appropriate proof of purchase showing the details I needed, and, as a further apology, initiated a refund.

The first-line support experience fell short, but the complaints team more than made up for it. Taking ownership, listening and fixing the problem is exactly what I hoped for. I've updated my rating to 5 stars and will continue using Lebara.

reviews.title: AVOID AT ALL COSTS, GO LOCAL SIM OR A COMPANY THAT IS ESTABLISHED
reviews.body:
AVOID LEBARA TRAVEL AT ALL COSTS
My original message on trustpilot was...
Ali really helped, amongst the best at Lebaras usually great customer service.... the app wasn't working and I had to phone up. 
I was told everything was fine for when I arrived in Mexico.... It really wasn't, i was left stranded in Mexico without internet and spent literally over 8 hours trying to sort it with them. IT NEVER WORKED. 
If it wasn't for someone letting me their WiFi I would have been screwed at the beginning. 
Don't have faith. 
App and SIM are full of bugs.
Really not worth it. 
Go with a local SIM or established travel SIM company. 
It's not worth the hassle. 
When things were going wrong they really weren't helped and I've some of the screenshots to prove it 

AVOID!
